options.2: By picking up red light emitted by the nebula
options.3: Using radio equipment that picks up regular pulses
options.4: By measuring how its mass varies over time

options.2: It can be made out of the wool of Grennock mountain sheep
options.3: It can be made out of the wool of any type of sheep
options.4: It can be made out of the wool of Cheshire mountain sheep

questions.question: Which of the following are true of how Bracklin is woven? Select all that apply.

options.1: Two threads lock around each other during weaving
options.2: The interlocking binds two layers of cloth together without any stitching
options.3: Three threads are braided together tightly
options.4: The layers are bound together afterward with hand-stitching

questions.question: How is bracklin made? Select all that apply.

options.1: Double-weft interlock weaving
options.2: Double-warp chain weaving
options.3: Cross-thread basket weaving
options.4: Single-strand satin weaving

questions.question: Which of the following correctly describes Bracklin?

options.1: An animal-based fiber used for winter carpets and ceremonial wall tapestries
options.2: An animal-based fiber used for summer garments and ceremonial robes
options.3: A plant-based fiber used for winter carpets and ceremonial wall tapestries
options.4: A plant-based fiber used for summer garments and ceremonial robes

questions.question: Which of the following correctly describes a feature of bracklin? Select all that apply.

options.1: It comes in shades ranging from warm ivory to ash grey
options.2: It comes in shades ranging from pale green to straw yellow
options.3: It is produced mainly for winter outerwear and ceremonial robes
options.4: It is produced mainly for summer clothing and decorative hangings
